audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..2].side read 'Skill' while win[0..2] read 'Azir', and phases[4].side read 'Skill' while win[4] read 'Anivia'. Four rows rendered two different answers.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly (Azir, Azir, Azir, Skill, Anivia, Azir, Skill), so the full layer was the outlier.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides aligned to the packet and content layer on rows 0-2 and 4, each with its why rewritten to argue the same verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 row credited Azir with dive insurance and 2v2 wins on a row the chart gives to Anivia.
audit.why: Glacial Storm is a 60-mana toggle on a 4/3/2s cooldown that slows and, once fully formed, primes Frostbite to double. Her 6 changes the lane's geometry; Azir's does not.
audit.corrected: Level 6 row now states the storm-into-Frostbite double and tells you to fight outside it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Crystallize was called '(E)' twice — it is her W. Her E is Frostbite. Nothing stated that Crystallize is an impassable wall that sits between you and the soldier you want to E to.
audit.why: Kit file: W Crystallize 'impassable wall of ice to block all movement', 17s flat, 1000 range; E Frostbite 4s, 650, doubles on a target recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm. Azir's E is flagged as a dash walls can deny.
audit.corrected: Slot corrected in wants.foe[1] and spikes[2].text; the wall-versus-dash check written into phases[2].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, and the packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing advice in the whole matchup.
audit.corrected: Flash Frost 11s at rank 1, Frostbite 4s, Crystallize 17s flat, your E 19s at rank 3, plus mana costs (Q 80, R 60) used as a shove trigger in dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading advice never named the range gap that decides the early lane.
audit.why: Frostbite is 650 and your soldier attacks cover 525 from a soldier you place — she has to walk into your sand to use her main damage, while Flash Frost at 1075 is dodgeable.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[1].why, dosFull[1].t and dosFull[1].d.
